adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts`, a refresh-token exchange is now performed immediately after reading `credential.key` (the code calls `fetch("https://login.salesforce.com/services/oauth2/token", ...)` and then `prisma.credential.update(...)`) with no expiry/validity check before doing so. This does introduce an unconditional network round-trip and DB write along the code path that creates the `jsforce.Connection`. However, the diff alone doesn’t prove this happens on *every* “service instantiation” (depends on how the service is constructed/used elsewhere), nor that it definitively “breaks cached-token usage” (that’s a design/perf/resilience concern rather than a directly verifiable correctness failure from the diff alone).
